questions.question: What does Tadeusz Jędrzejowski discover in his secret folder?
answers: Only errors in the holiday records
Fake contracts, shifts and forged signatures in the healthcare system
Plans for renovating the hospital
A love letter to his wife
questions.explanation: The folder contains names of doctors on multiple posts, fake shifts and his forged signatures.

answers: To retire abroad
To the prosecutor's office to give testimony
To a medical conference in Berlin
To civil court for a divorce

answers: Both concern the same building
In both cases someone decided that someone's life and death don't matter
Both were invented by the media
Both concern only foreign policy
questions.explanation: The final text juxtaposes the bones in the forest and the people dying in the emergency room as cases of disregard for life.

He goes abroad to his daughter

answers: Because he can't read documents
